title: Commit the ops overlay as a new dataset version
description: Bakes the effective dataframe (original + all overlay ops) into a brand-new Parquet dataset via storage.save_dataset — the original dataset id and its Parquet file are left untouched. The frontend must re-point dataset-store at the returned dataset id. Old versions accumulate on disk until explicitly deleted via data.delete.

dataset.description: Metadata of the newly created dataset version
